title: Implement structure decision via generateObject (Stage 2)
description: Implement src/lib/ai/generate-structure.ts. This calls Claude with the condensed business profile and asks it to select and order 7-10 sections from the 21 available types. Returns a typed StructureDecision with section list, tone, and palette hint.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns a `StructureDecision` with sections array (7-10 items), tone, paletteHint
Sections array always starts with 'hero' and ends with 'contact' or 'cta_banner'
Prompt includes business name, industry, location, and condensed profile summary

steps.details:
The prompt in `src/lib/ai/prompts.ts`:
```
You are designing the structure of a professional website for: ${businessName}, a ${industry} business in ${location}.

Business profile: ${summary}

Select 7-10 sections from this list that would make the most compelling website for this specific business: [list all 21 types with descriptions].

Rules:
- hero MUST be first
- contact or cta_banner MUST be last  
- Minimum 7, maximum 10 sections
- Be specific to the industry and location
- Choose sections that showcase what makes this business valuable
```

Call `generateObject({ model, schema: structureSchema, prompt: buildStructurePrompt(profile, prospect) })`. After receiving the result, enforce the rules: if sections[0].type !== 'hero', prepend a hero section. If last section is not 'contact' or 'cta_banner', append a contact section.
Call `generateStructure` with a test profile and inspect the returned sections. Verify: 7-10 sections, hero first, contact last. Check that the sections make sense for the given industry.

technicalNotes: The prompt should include descriptions of each section type to help the AI choose appropriately.
The variant field in the structure decision can be left to the AI or hardcoded to 'default' and resolved later by TASK-47 (variant assignment).
